decisions.title: Owner-based file write authorization
decisions.factual_question: Which current-owner checks must accompany each reference/owner/byte mutation that can widen file access?
options: Existing operation rights plus every current owner’s read authorization, checked atomically
Dedicated file-management authority with explicitly scoped operations
decisions.recommendation: Use existing operation rights plus authorization against every current owner; cover detach/delete/replace, cascades, shared references and derivatives.
decisions.consequence: Removes some current MASTER_DATA_EDIT operations; record the breaking change and tests. Read-policy choices F1–F5/F3′/view-key are already answered.

decisions.title: Numeric boundary and invalid-present fields
decisions.factual_question: What replaces purified or unusable numeric fields that currently succeed with changed meaning?
options: Raw field-aware validation; refuse nonfinite/rewritten/unusable supplied values before mutation
Detect purifier rewrites and refuse them; explicitly retain named no-op/ignore behavior
decisions.recommendation: Use raw field-aware validation and 400/no mutation for invalid-present recipe IDs, shopping amounts and product IDs. Preserve established valid per-field numeric strings. Report existing nonfinite rows without rewriting them.
decisions.consequence: Changes accepted inputs/results in #916/#946/#947/#950. Nonpositive remove no-op versus error must be named; ordinary-space acceptance and decision O1 are not open questions.

decisions.title: Battery and shopping read boundaries
decisions.factual_question: Should tracking-only battery calls and shopping-only pages receive currently returned domain data?
options: Require BATTERIES_VIEW before charge mutation; gate shopping barcodes/shortfall on STOCK_VIEW
Keep tracking-only calls with a reduced response; explicitly permit shopping data as a domain exception
decisions.recommendation: Require view for charge response/mutation and gate shopping data; assess undo separately because its 204 does not itself reveal a new row.
decisions.consequence: Permission or response breaks need coordinated contracts. Do not reopen accepted #909 battery CRUD deferral. These are separate choices within one decision batch.

decisions.title: Unusable conversion-chain policy
decisions.factual_question: Should conversion writes refuse unusable resolved chains, or should resolution skip/clamp them?
options: Atomic refusal with a specific error and no writes
decisions.recommendation: Atomic refusal preserves conversion meaning; reproduce both overflow and reciprocal underflow first.
decisions.consequence: Already-refused overflow is not silent corruption. Skipping/clamping would change relationships; decision L for scalar factors does not answer this.

decisions.title: Adopt additional production dispositions

options: Adopt R1–R5; decide R6 through D2
Adopt selected gates and explicitly record each residual’s affected operation/account and restriction
decisions.recommendation: Adopt R1–R5. Require a reasoned disposition of #930/#942, not a claim of confirmed corruption or a passing-rerun waiver.
